race.comment: KILLENAULE (10) has been a frustrating conveyance for punters of late but continues to race very well, beaten by the barest of margins at Pakenham Synthetic last start as the odds-on favourite. Back onto turf now and he sets up for every chance in run. PARIAH PEARL (7) won dominantly here two back then battled well in the Pinker Pinker Plate last time. She goes well here and will kick up from the low gate. SARAPO (12) looks suited rising in trip fourth up. He got home well at Geelong behind an in-form horse and should be right there. COVERT THINKING (4) is racing consistently and draws well, each way.
